verdict.rationale: dLocal is API-first for its core money flows: payments, custom checkout, saved cards, wallet enrollments and cancellation, and status notifications. However, nothing documents that dashboard functions are also exposed through the API. Those dashboard functions include credentials, transaction tracking, payment-method management, reports and no-integration payment links, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented API-to-UI parity statement, API coverage of dashboard reports/payment-method management/payment links, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: With dLocal API you can build your own payment form and take full control over the look and feel and experience of your checkout.
The important parameters are returned via API, so the merchant can build their own Pix UI.
Cancel an enrollment: cancel an active enrollment when a user unsubscribes or changes their payment method.
